texts:
Tuesday's news, team by team: a lost season in Washington, a release in New York, returns in three cities and Thursday's practice reports.

Terry McLaurin is out for the year.

Najee Harris is gone.

Tank Dell is back.
#RaiseHail #NYGiants #HTownMade

Terry McLaurin tore the patellar tendon in his left knee at SF, and Dan Quinn says surgery ends his season. Drop him for any add.

Stefon Diggs is the top receiver when Washington comes off the bye. WR30 rest of season for me; hold him.
#RaiseHail

Antonio Williams led Washington's receivers in snaps and routes in Week 6, and McLaurin's outside spot opens when Washington returns in Week 8.

Stash Williams, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB.
#RaiseHail

The Giants released Najee Harris after 31 carries for 99 yards in five games, 3.2 a carry. Drop him in every format.

Tyrone Tracy Jr. played 38 percent of the snaps vs NO and scored twice on 8 touches. Add him, 0 to 2 percent of FAAB.
#NYGiants

Houston plans to activate Tank Dell off IR for NYG, his first game since the 2024 knee injury. Monitor his route share Sunday.

Jaylin Noel caught 4 for 107 and a TD at JAX, but Dell takes slot snaps from him. Add Noel in deep leagues, 1 to 3 percent.
#HTownMade

TreVeyon Henderson practiced in full Monday and Tuesday on the ankle before Thursday at CHI, but Corey Kiner closed out the Jets after Henderson's fumble.

RB26 rest of season for me. Hold Henderson; a second game with Kiner taking the late carries makes him a sell.
#NEPats

A.J. Brown was limited Monday and Tuesday with the ankle and is not expected to miss Thursday. He ran a route on 97 percent of the dropbacks and drew 10 targets vs NYJ, and Romeo Doubs is on IR.

WR24 rest of season for me; hold him through the drops.
#NEPats

Kyle Monangai missed practice again Tuesday with the thumb and toe and is very unlikely for Thursday vs NE. RB29 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's report.

D'Andre Swift leads Chicago's backfield again. RB13 rest of season for me; hold him.
#DaBears #NEPats

Matt LaFleur would not commit to Josh Jacobs for Sunday at DET. RB37 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's practice report.

MarShawn Lloyd ran 8 times for 10 on 30 snaps vs DAL. RB41 rest of season for me; drop him for any add.
#GoPackGo #OnePride

Mike Macdonald says there is a good chance Zach Charbonnet plays Sunday vs KC. The fill-ins split 46 and 27 snaps, so the early downs are his when he is back.

RB47 rest of season for me. Monitor Seattle's Wednesday practice report.
#Seahawks #ChiefsKingdom

Minnesota opened Jordan Mason's window to return from IR before Sunday vs IND, and he takes the early downs once active. RB35 rest of season for me. Monitor his activation.

Aaron Jones Sr. is RB32 rest of season for me; hold him until Mason is active.
#Skol #ForTheShoe

Jesse Minter called Lamar Jackson day to day with the ankle after two missed games and said he could practice this week before CIN.

QB2 rest of season for me. Monitor Baltimore's Wednesday practice report.
#RavensFlock #WhoDey

Mike Evans has Achilles tendinitis that flared Monday night, after 3 catches for 94 yards. San Francisco is bracing for him to miss Sunday at ATL, with the bye in Week 8.

WR26 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's practice report.
#FTTB #DirtyBirds

Baker Mayfield is set to practice Wednesday on the dislocated thumb, but Todd Bowles is still planning for Jalon Daniels to make a fourth straight start at CAR.

Mayfield is QB24 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's practice report.
#GoBucs #KeepPounding

Jeremiyah Love was set to run Tuesday on the ankle after missing Week 6, when Bam Knight ran 15 times for 80 at LAR.

Love is RB15 rest of season for me. Monitor Arizona's Wednesday practice report before Sunday at DEN.
#BirdGang #BroncosCountry

Blake Corum took 9 of the 19 back carries at ARI and has scored two weeks running, while Kyren Williams held 72 percent of the snaps.

Corum is RB27 rest of season for me; hold him for the short-yardage work.
#RamsHouse

Every note from today is on the Pass, with Wednesday's practice reports and the Menu next.

Follow @FF_ChefHazy for the Week 7 ranks, and repost this for your league.
